summary: Checkpoint accounting tests verify the filesystem's actual copy strategy on macOS and Linux instead of assuming VACUUM INTO.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: Test-only change. A copy probe into the checkpoint scratch filesystem determines the exact expected accounting method: clone on clone-capable filesystems, or vacuum_into on the existing fallback path. Production behavior and status metadata are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Nothing stored changes; reverting restores the previous test expectation.
